label: help_core_rollout_real_rollout
command: docker exec s2r-sim s2r-entrypoint python -m core.rollout.real_rollout --help
output:
usage: real_rollout.py [-h] [--config_path CONFIG_PATH] [--arm ARM]
                       [--scene SCENE] [--task TASK] [--variant VARIANT]
                       [--unit UNIT] --policy POLICY
                       [--policy_host POLICY_HOST] [--policy_port POLICY_PORT]
                       [--policy_option KEY=VALUE] [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                       [--lang_instruction LANG_INSTRUCTION]
                       [--action_horizon ACTION_HORIZON] [--episodes EPISODES]
                       [--episode_seconds EPISODE_SECONDS] [--enable-motion]
                       [--max_start_error MAX_START_ERROR]
                       [--max_relative_target MAX_RELATIVE_TARGET]
                       [--release-on-exit] [--follower_port FOLLOWER_PORT]
                       [--follower_id FOLLOWER_ID]
                       [--camera_gripper CAMERA_GRIPPER]
                       [--camera_external CAMERA_EXTERNAL]
                       [--camera_width CAMERA_WIDTH]
                       [--camera_height CAMERA_HEIGHT]
                       [--camera_fourcc CAMERA_FOURCC]
                       [--rename_map RENAME_MAP] [--fps FPS] [--output OUTPUT]
                       [--no_prompt]

Run a served policy on the physical follower. Shadow mode (no motion) unless --enable-motion is given.

Run it in the sim/teleop container after the policy server is up (`s2r serve <policy>`). No simulator starts.

    s2r rollout --policy molmoact2 --lang_instruction "Pick up the blue cube and place it in the white box"

The arm is configured from the same variables as the recorder: ROBOT_PORT, ROBOT_ID, CAMERA_GRIPPER,
CAMERA_EXTERNAL, CAMERA_WIDTH, CAMERA_HEIGHT, CAMERA_FOURCC and CONTROL_FPS. The arm must already be calibrated
(`lerobot-calibrate`); this script never starts calibration. On exit the arm keeps holding its last goal.

Units are raw LeRobot units, the same ones the simulator mapping uses: -100..100 for the body joints and 0..100
for the gripper. Nothing is sent to the arm unless motion is enabled. Stopping never releases torque unless
--release-on-exit is given.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config_path CONFIG_PATH
                        rollout YAML; explicit flags override its defaults
  --arm ARM
  --scene SCENE
  --task TASK
  --variant VARIANT
  --unit UNIT           arm calibration unit ID
  --policy POLICY       policy folder name under policies/
  --policy_host POLICY_HOST
  --policy_port POLICY_PORT
                        default: the policy's default_port
  --policy_option KEY=VALUE
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
                        label stored in the report; the server decides what is
                        loaded
  --lang_instruction LANG_INSTRUCTION
                        default: the selected task's instruction
  --action_horizon ACTION_HORIZON
                        default: the policy manifest horizon
  --episodes EPISODES
  --episode_seconds EPISODE_SECONDS
  --enable-motion       actually move the arm; without it the policy is
                        queried and logged only
  --max_start_error MAX_START_ERROR
                        refuse an episode whose first target is farther than
                        this (raw units) from the pose
  --max_relative_target MAX_RELATIVE_TARGET
                        per-command step limit, raw units, enforced by the
                        follower driver
  --release-on-exit     disable torque on exit; the arm will drop
  --follower_port FOLLOWER_PORT
  --follower_id FOLLOWER_ID
  --camera_gripper CAMERA_GRIPPER
  --camera_external CAMERA_EXTERNAL
  --camera_width CAMERA_WIDTH
  --camera_height CAMERA_HEIGHT
  --camera_fourcc CAMERA_FOURCC
  --rename_map RENAME_MAP
                        robot camera name -> policy camera name (JSON)
  --fps FPS
  --output OUTPUT       report folder (default
                        outputs/real_rollout/<timestamp>)
  --no_prompt           do not ask for resets or outcomes (outcomes unlabeled)
